newsitem.title: USA: O'Reilly Automotive sets growth plan as Q1 rises.
newsitem.headline: O'Reilly Automotive sets growth plan as Q1 rises.

text.p: O'Reilly Automotive Inc, which reported an increase in earnings in the first quarter ended March 31, said Wednesday it added a net of 10 stores in the period and plans to open 50 stores in 1998.

The auto parts manufacturer posted net income of $5.0 million, or $0.48 a share, in the latest period, compared to $4.1 million, or $0.39, one year ago. Sales rose to $68.5 million from $55.3 million in the first quarter of 1996.
O'Reilly, which operates a total of 229 stores, said an increase in its gross profit margin stemmed from changes in the product mix and improvements in its product acquisition programs.
O'Reilly shares closed unchanged Wednesday at 35-1/2.
